Question 16
?

Find a Cartesian equation of the line shown in the figure above.

a
x−4−1=y+31=z+24
b
x−14=y+1−3=z+4−2
c
x+4−1=y−31=z−24
d
x4=y−3=z−2
e
x+14=y−1−3=z−4−2
